hypotheses.claim: The threshold isn't the bug: SPEC.md says never open the gripper because of the ultrasonic reading while holding, so any proximity release in the HOLDING branch is wrong.
hypotheses.how_to_check: Read SPEC.md's holding rule, remove the release branch in step(), and run d1_hand_trace: the gripper should stay closed for the whole trace.

hypotheses.claim: Each lower threshold only moves the release point, because the hand keeps approaching (31, 18, 12 mm).
hypotheses.how_to_check: Compare the dist_mm at each release with the threshold you set; if it always releases just under it, stop tuning the number.
